notes.title: Major Update 1.4.0.0: Caves are here!
notes.notes:
The biggest content update yet is now available! A multitude of new locations, quests, and NPCs await you!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3442760/

[h1]Content Update 1.4.0.0 Notes[/h1]
[h2]New Weapon:[/h2]
[*] A brand-new weapon is available in-game: the Shotgun! Obtain this new weapon from the traveling weapons merchants who roam the maps!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45460402/f0c7fe806a8ecb6a9d45086555cc24402db08ffd.png[/img]

[h2] New Location: The Caves[/h2]
Cave entrances have been discovered! Be careful, this new location is home to many hostile creatures.
These caves are procedurally generated, so you'll never encounter the same cave twice!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45460402/b2eab757d485d694ac70a7aa03b3562f64e6408a.png[/img]

[h2] New quests:[/h2]
[*] Quest for an NPC disguised as a zombie: While exploring a cave, you discovered a refuge where humans live, but what could they possibly be doing here...
[*] Quest for an NPC disguised as a zombie: You met a grandpa who's watching zombies?! Go find him for more information...

[h2] New Achievements:[/h2]
[*] It's so dark in here...... - Enter a cave for the first time.

[h2] New Creature Variant:[/h2]
[*] Hiders: Hiders can now hide under a rock.
[*] Spider: Spiders can now spawn without their prey.

[h2] Online multiplayer coming to Apocalypse? No! It's only in beta![/h2]
[*] From the game's main menu, you can now play online, whether with strangers or your friends!
[*] As this feature is in beta, you may experience numerous bugs, synchronization inconsistencies, and lags during your game. We apologize for any inconvenience.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45460402/9d0a0a0d87c6169e5c9bd48cad371f7c3df8b12c.png[/img]

[h2]Other minor additions and changes:[/h2]
[*] Maps numbered 1, 18, and 31 have been modified to include cave entrances.
[*] Bullet textures have been modified.
[*] Bullet spawn coordinates have been modified to be more consistent.
[*] Zombie groups now have their own set speed, they can now spawn in groups of 3. 
[*] A bar is now displayed when you reload a weapon. 
[*] Didirock-shaped rocks can now spawn on maps.
[*] Hiders' health bars are now displayed and no longer hidden.
[*] Gunshot sounds are now played at a slightly different pitch. [*] When you use your companion's treasure search mode, they will now stay next to the treasure until you retrieve it.
[*] Aiming at a hostile creature with the mouse cursor is now more accurate.
[*] Added a loot chest upon killing the zombie boss.
[*] The zombie boss can no longer respawn immediately.
[*] The T key on the keyboard and the down button on the D-Pad for controllers are used to change companion modes; this is now explained in the skill tree.
[*] Explosions now spawn fire on the ground.
[*] The selection texture in an interface has been modified to be more visible.
[*] Hiders are now faster when they no longer have their protection on their backs.
[*] Fixed some textures in the inventory that were incorrect.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented interaction with certain NPCs with a controller.

[h3]Numerous fixes, bug fixes, and other improvements have been made to improve the game experience.[/h3]

Found a bug? Report it on our Discord server: [url=https://discord.gg/Edrg4r4q5b]https://discord.gg/Edrg4r4q5b[/url]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3442760/

[h2]A minor update has just been released![/h2]

notes.title: Small Update - Patch Note
notes.notes:
[h2]A minor update has just been released! [/h2]
[h3]Here are the changes:[/h3]

- You can now choose how you want to target enemies! You can leave auto-targeting on or use the cursor to target enemies! By default, you will have to use your mouse to target enemies.
- The number of creatures at the start of the game has been reduced again; creatures now deal less damage.
- The skill tree for the pet now has icons.
- The tutorial that appears at the start of a new game now remains displayed even after opening and closing an interface.
- Changed the speed of weapon bullets.

notes.title: Content Update: New Maps, New Weapon, New NPCs and more!
notes.notes:
The biggest content update is now available! To celebrate the launch of this update and the start of the Spring Sale, a 20% off promotion is available for the purchase of the game until March 20!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3442760/

[h1]Content Update 1.3.0.0 Note[/h1]
[h2]New Weapon: [/h2]
[*] A brand new weapon is available in the game: the Flamethrower! Have fun burning enemy creatures, find this new weapon via one of the traveling merchants who walk around the maps!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45460402/06e2a0366576da4a2cb8640e3261b752bd5a3886.png[/img]

[h2] 5 new maps & a bigger world: [/h2]
The world size is growing, going from a 6x5 map world to a [b]6x6 map world[/b]! That's a total of [b]36 maps to explore ![/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45460402/6570f51b70d409ef663a2840a2d22a7d2b6cab4a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45460402/b081624d45751a39fb629aec767f8b96c6654e17.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45460402/1f12adbd678c4e73dbad7c1f325e916c3fc2a603.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45460402/60f3055bb80e2c399229610d845d8e04332b7bc9.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45460402/2c5debb8e42540a638d64910c2b4adc847e45325.png[/img]

[h2] New Quests:[/h2]
[*] NPC Alois Quest: One of the new maps in the update has a power outage, endangering the city, bring back gas cans and restart the city's generators.
[*] Player Quest: You have discovered a house in relatively good condition, you have undertaken to repair it to settle there.

[h2] New Achievements:[/h2]Good Luck! - Start a game in Apocalypse Hardcore mode!
[*] Zzz... - Enjoy a moment of respite to rest!

[h2] New Creature:[/h2]
[*] Sand Zombie: Beware of this creature, even if this creature looks almost like a normal zombie, its strength and power are much greater!

[h2]Mouse Compatibility:[/h2]
[*] Previously, interaction with the game menus was done with the keyboard arrows. Now, in addition to the keyboard arrows, you can interact with the mouse!

[h2]Other minor additions and changes:[/h2]
[*] A button to quit the game has been added to the main menu.
[*] Added a variant to the safe with a new mini-game.
[*] When the player takes damage, the edge of the screen is tinted with a red border.
[*] Explosions now generate a fire effect on the targets hit.
[*] The player's house has been modified and improved with a corner where your companion can now rest.
[*] Your companion can now do emotes in specific cases. Example: when he has no more HP, a distress emote is displayed.
[*] Now, when you switch the game to windowed or fullscreen mode, the option is saved and the game will now launch based on that option!
[*] When the player gets stuck in a bear trap, the movement keys are displayed with text to make it easier to understand.
[*] New buttons are now displayed on the menus to make it easier to understand how to use them.
[*] The number of creatures that spawn has been increased in Apocalypse & Apocalypse Hardcore.
[*] Mobs' health bars have been changed.
[*] Fixed a bug with the hunter animation.
[*] Fixed a bug that would cause the Escape menu to open when the inventory was closed.

[h3]Many fixes, bug fixes, and various improvements have been made to improve the game experience.

Found a bug? Report it on our discord server: [url=https://discord.gg/Edrg4r4q5b]https://discord.gg/Edrg4r4q5b[/url]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3442760/

[h1]Coming in the next updates:[/h1]
[*] Cave entrances seem to have been discovered...
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45460402/68dbb80f699431be902942365c6f144266ade7bf.png[/img]
